raw.rationale: CCT018159 is an early resorcinol-based HSP90 inhibitor with modest potency and poor selectivity, and in PRISM-style single-concentration screens HSP90 inhibitors typically show broad, weak antiproliferative effects rather than strong lineage-restricted killing; known HSP90 client dependencies (e.g., mutant EGFR/KRAS, HER2, hormone receptors) might slightly enrich effects in lung, breast, and gastric lineages, but selective lineage-level mean log2FC ≤ -0.5 is rare.
